hookText: Dutch privacy watchdog tells people not

beats.say: The Dutch data protection authority tested six unnamed AI smart glasses and advised against buying them after they claimed to have called an ambulance when they had not.
The glasses cost from under 100 euros to over 500 euros, but the AP did not name the brands or call for a sales ban.
The Dutch privacy watchdog, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, has told people not to buy smart glasses, saying they can get things dangerously wrong.
